objective: Conduct comprehensive audit and design of army supply chains and defense industry. Evaluate procurement via tenders, treat military equipment as depreciating capital goods. Analyze storage for equipment, ammo, and gunpowder using existing warehouse assets and storage payment logic. Audit defense industry scaling, production methods, and genesis state. Design gradual civilian-to-military industry conversion preventing economic collapse. Calculate military equipment requirements strictly from actual strategic army needs, NOT population metrics. Define strict counterparty for all logistics costs including FreightCapacity and StorageCapacity.
constraints: RAM protection: cargo check and cargo clippy only
RBAC: no git checkout/switch/reset/rebase/clean
Rule 1: All procurement payments must have strict counterparty (Ministry of Defense → defense company); no fiat creation
Rule 2: Equipment depreciation rates and storage costs must scale by average_wage and equipment value, not flat rates
Rule 3: Physical BOM for military equipment must be static; financial costs derived from market clearing prices
Rule 4: Defense factories must have complete lifecycle: genesis, production, conversion, bankruptcy/liquidation
Rule 5: Equipment allocation to units must use pro-rata based on unit manpower and ToE deficit
Rule 6: No TODOs for conversion logic — write actual filtering and routing
Rule 7: Each unit's equipment reserves must remain individually tracked
Rule 13: Defense factories must have distinct MethodSlots (Production, Automation, Organization)
Rule 15: Storage costs must scale by warehouse capacity and commodity volume
Rule 16: Equipment degradation must occur BEFORE procurement orders in the turn sequence
Rule 18: Civilian-to-military conversion must have trade-offs
Rule 19: Equipment transport must consume FreightCapacity; no teleportation
Rule 20: Warehouse storage must have hard capacity limits with overflow behavior
Rule 22: Do not modify fertilizer, sports, environment, or housing modules
Rule 23: Surgically extend military/ modules and append to production_methods_data.rs
CRITICAL: Military equipment requirements must be calculated based strictly on actual strategic needs of the army, NOT on general population metrics
LOGISTICS COUNTERPARTY: Ministry of Defense pays ALL FreightCapacity costs. MoD debited from country.budget, freight company credited.

STORAGE COUNTERPARTY: Ministry of Defense pays ALL StorageCapacity warehouse rent. MoD debited from country.budget, warehouse-owning company credited. MoD pays same market rate as commercial tenants. If MoD cannot afford storage, equipment degrades or must be sold/scrapped.
Use: bash .devin/scripts/request_integration.sh when done
